Junior Developer – Join the Ōnin Team! 

 Who We Are 
At The Ōnin Group, we don’t just support business operations — we create environments where teams thrive. As a Best Places to Work company, we invest in our people through industry-leading benefits, professional development, and a culture rooted in service, innovation, and performance.

 About the Role 
We’re looking for a Junior Developer to join our development team onsite in Nashville, TN. In this role, you’ll help build and maintain applications that support critical parts of Ōnin’s business — from internal operational tools and employee-facing applications to third-party integrations and data workflows.
This is a great opportunity for someone with a foundation in programming and web development who wants to grow their skills, solve real-world problems, and build technology that makes people’s jobs easier.

 What You’ll Do 
 Develop and maintain web-based applications with support from experienced developers
 Help build and maintain APIs and integrations between internal and third-party systems
 Write SQL queries and work with relational databases and datasets
 Investigate and resolve application issues with guidance from the team
 Write clear, maintainable code and participate in code reviews
 Help improve the performance and reliability of existing applications
 Support reporting processes and data integrations
 Learn from and contribute to technical design discussions
 Gain experience with cloud-hosted applications and services
 Collaborate with developers and business teams to understand needs and build practical solutions
 Participate in daily standups, project planning, and the software development lifecycle
 Maintain technical documentation and build skills across the stack as project needs evolve
 Ideal Candidate 
 Foundational experience with software or web development through work, internships, coursework, or personal projects
 Understanding of programming fundamentals, web development, and HTTP/API concepts
 Familiarity with relational databases and SQL
 Familiarity with Git or another version-control tool
 Willingness to troubleshoot problems, ask questions, and learn from feedback
 Ability to learn unfamiliar technologies and understand how applications and services interact
 Strong communication and collaboration skills
 Exposure to programming languages, web frameworks, REST APIs, cloud platforms, or third-party integrations is a plus
 Curious and interested in exploring existing code, logs, database queries, and APIs
 Able to manage assigned work while collaborating closely with a team
 Our technology environment includes Python, Django, Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL, SQL, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, Bootstrap, Git/GitHub, Google Cloud Platform, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, BigQuery, REST APIs, and third-party integrations. You don’t need experience with everything in our stack on day one.
 Why Join Us? 
At The Ōnin Group, you’ll be part of a small development team where you can make a direct impact on the technology we build. You’ll have opportunities to learn from experienced developers, understand business problems, build and deploy applications, and improve them based on real-world use.
We empower our employees through our Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), ensuring you share in our success. Our Ōninite Total Rewards program includes:
 Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)
 Competitive bonuses
 401(k) with 3% company match
 Medical, dental, and vision insurance
 Paid vacation and holidays
 RelyMD telemedicine
 Free counseling and legal services
 Tuition reimbursement
 And more!
 #LI-DNI
 
 Your next opportunity could be right here. Apply today!
